description: Returns how many MCP servers were first published on or after a date, split by namespace type. Example output: {"since":"2026-10-01","count":16045}. Optional argument: date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example "2026-10-01". With no arguments it counts the last 30 days up to the snapshot date. Good for 'How many new MCP servers since October?'.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example "2026-10-01". Optional: empty means the last 30 days up to the snapshot date.
date.title: Date

name: new_servers_count_since
